segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned near the test tubes on the table, preparing to interact with them.
The robot arm moves towards the test tubes, positioning its grippers to pick up the yellow and red pigment test tubes.
The robot arm grasps the test tubes with yellow and red pigment, lifting them from the table.
The robot arm moves the test tubes towards the beaker, positioning them above the beaker for pouring.
The robot arm pours the yellow pigment test tube into the beaker, then the red pigment test tube into the beaker.
The robot arm places the empty test tubes back on the table and retracts its grippers.
